operator_io_quirks: Empty tables: language, staff, store, film_text have 0 rows -> original_values empty, original_sizes 0; FK children (film.language_id, customer.store_id, store.manager_staff_id, staff.address_id) draw from empty parents -> NULLs -> NOT NULL insert failures skipped.

Cycle: store.manager_staff_id -> staff, staff.address_id -> address, store.address_id -> address, customer.store_id -> store; store<->staff is a table-level cycle (store->staff, staff has no store FK in pragma since commented out) but store->staff and staff->address->city->country chain; process_order must break deterministically.
staff DDL has commented-out '--FOREIGN KEY (store_id) REFERENCES store' line; pragma foreign_key_list will NOT report it, but the line-based unique/check scan sees the text; do not treat as FK.

film.rating and film.special_features have EMPTY declared type '' -> ts_fuzzer String (rule 2: '' -> String); rating values are enum-like {G,PG,PG-13,R,NC-17}, special_features comma-joined multi-values.
film.release_year YEAR -> Number(scale=4) per rule 6; original single value 2006 (integer storage); TS will emit huge ints in [-10^4,10^4].
All TIMESTAMP/DATETIME columns stored as TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (space separator, not T); Date fuzzer template must parse this; last_update often distinct=1 (constant 2006-02-15 ...).
customer.create_date distinct=2 (2006-02-14 22:04:36/37) -> Date range degenerate (<2 distinct) -> falls back to 1800..2100 full range.
film.original_language_id null_rate=1.0, distinct=0 -> all NULL; FK to language (empty) anyway.
payment.rental_id nullable INT with 5 NULLs, FK to rental; rental_id values sparse (not 1..16044 contiguous).
DECIMAL(4,2)/(5,2) stored as REAL (rental_rate, replacement_cost, amount) but amount also has integer storage class (2.99 vs 0.99 mixed) -> Number float path; scale=4 precision=2.
film_text.film_id SMALLINT (signed, no UNSIGNED) vs film.film_id SMALLINT UNSIGNED; no FK declared between them though logically 1:1.
Composite PKs: film_actor(actor_id,film_id), film_category(film_id,category_id) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30; single-col PKs get inf.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on *_id columns: full range [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from (a,b) args; SMALLINT UNSIGNED -> scale 0 -> [-1,1] then perturb +-1/+-2 -> tiny ints, mostly 0/1/2; PK uniqueness filtering keeps few rows -> small tables.
TINYINT UNSIGNED (store_id, staff_id, category_id, language_id) -> scale 0 -> values in {-2..2} -> FK joins to store/staff (2 rows) plausible but category/language tiny.
MEDIUMINT UNSIGNED inventory_id -> scale 0 -> [-1,1]; inventory PK collapses to ~3 rows.

Date fuzzer on TIMESTAMP/DATETIME: template from first parsable element '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'; range from min/max of 5 sampled originals; last_update constant -> degenerate -> 1800..2100 random datetimes -> implausible vs 2005-2006 originals (FN source for date-range predicates).

String fuzzer on first_name/last_name/title/city/country: random CHARSET a-zA-Z0-9() strings + contaminate -> implausible names; literal pool from train SQL may inject some real values but p=0.2 fresh dominates.
String on email: random strings, no '@' structure -> email LIKE '%@%' predicates miss (FN).
String on rating/special_features (empty type): random strings, not enum members -> rating='PG' predicates miss (FN); no ties/duplicates from enum.
Bool on active: True/False (1/0) w.p. p else element -> fine; but customer.active all 1 in original, TS mixes -> plausible.

FK consistency: child draws from parent FINAL filtered values; empty parents (language, staff, store) -> NULL -> NOT NULL insert fails -> film/customer/store rows dropped -> many tables near-empty (FP/FN from missing rows).

PK filtering: sample_fresh_primary_keys keeps first occurrence; with tiny Number ranges (e.g. store_id in {-2..2}) composite PKs collapse -> film_actor/film_category tiny -> join cardinalities wrong (FP on COUNT).

Number list-range quirk (list_max overwritten to full max) means even with literal pool values like 4.99, fresh draws span [-10^4,10^4] for DECIMAL(5,2) -> amount/rental_rate implausible (FN on amount>X).
Empty tables (language, staff, store, film_text) get sizes from choose_table_sizes (>=1) but FK children fail insert -> effectively empty -> queries on staff/store return 0 rows (FP).
